Definition: properly, shut up, i.e. the breast (as enclosing the heart); also gold (as generally shut up safely)
BiblicalUsage: çᵉgôwr — shut up, the breast, also gold kept safely — turns up in Hosea among its 2 occurrences. It is a small word, and it stays in its own lane.
TheologicalSignificance: To me, çᵉgôwr is a small window into how precisely God speaks.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
